description: One File Services server: SMB services, monitors, alerts and counters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 200
  g.Path AS Host,
  CASE g.HealthState WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS Health,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(v.Path, CHARINDEX(';', v.Path + ';') - 1) = g.Path
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.Service.SMB.10.0')) AS "SMB services",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(v.Path, CHARINDEX(';', v.Path + ';') - 1) = g.Path AND v.HealthState IN (2, 3)
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.Service.SMB.10.0')) AS "SMB services not healthy",
  g.StateLastModified AS LastStateChange
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g
WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (${fshost:singlequote})
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.10.0.FileServer')
ORDER BY CASE g.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, g.Path

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (${fshost:singlequote})
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.10.0.FileServer')) AS "File Services servers",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (${fshost:singlequote}) AND g.HealthState IN (2, 3)
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.10.0.FileServer')) AS "Servers not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (${fshost:singlequote})
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.Service.SMB.10.0')) AS "SMB services",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (${fshost:singlequote}) AND g.HealthState IN (2, 3)
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.Service.SMB.10.0')) AS "SMB services not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServ%'
     AND LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (${fshost:singlequote})) AS "Open File Services alerts"

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (${fshost:singlequote})
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.10.0.FileServer')) AS "File Services servers",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (${fshost:singlequote}) AND g.HealthState IN (2, 3)
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.10.0.FileServer')) AS "Servers not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (${fshost:singlequote})
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.Service.SMB.10.0')) AS "SMB services",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (${fshost:singlequote}) AND g.HealthState IN (2, 3)
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.Service.SMB.10.0')) AS "SMB services not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServ%'
     AND LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (${fshost:singlequote})) AS "Open File Services alerts"

SELECT TOP 1000
  REPLACE(REPLACE(g.DisplayName, 'SMB service ', ''), ' on ' + LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1), '') AS "SMB service",
  LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) AS Host,
  CASE g.HealthState WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS Health,
  g.StateLastModified AS LastStateChange
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g
WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (${fshost:singlequote})
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.Service.SMB.10.0')
ORDER BY CASE g.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, 3, 1

SELECT DISTINCT TOP 300
  CASE s.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Warning' END AS Health,
  COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 m.DisplayName FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.DisplayName IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.LanguageCode), s.MonitorName) AS Monitor,
  e.DisplayName AS Object,
  LEFT(COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName) + ';') - 1) AS Host,
  s.LastModified AS Since
FROM dbo.StateView s
JOIN dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView e ON e.Id = s.BaseManagedEntityId
WHERE s.HealthState IN (2, 3)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.IsUnitMonitor = 1)
  AND e.IsDeleted = 0 AND e.FullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServ%'
  AND LEFT(COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (${fshost:singlequote})
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 5 DESC

SELECT TOP 300
  CASE a.Severity WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 1 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Information' END AS Severity,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.AlertStringName, ''), a.Name) AS Alert,
  CAST(a.Id AS varchar(36)) AS AlertId,
  a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName AS Source,
  LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) AS Host,
  a.RepeatCount AS Repeats,
  a.TimeRaised AS Raised
FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a
WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.TimeRaised BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServ%'
  AND LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (${fshost:singlequote})
ORDER BY a.Severity DESC, a.TimeRaised DESC

WITH x AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS host,
         CASE WHEN et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.Service.SMB.10.0' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(e.DisplayName, 'SMB service ', ''), ' on ' + h.DisplayName, '') ELSE '(server)' END AS scope,
         r.ObjectName AS o, r.CounterName AS c, p.SampleValue AS v, p.DateTime AS t,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ManagedEntityRowId, r.RuleRowId, i.InstanceName ORDER BY p.DateTime DESC) AS rn
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType et ON et.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServ%'
    AND p.DateTime > DATEADD(hour, -24, GETUTCDATE())
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${fshost:singlequote})
)
SELECT TOP 500 host AS Host, scope AS Scope, o AS Object, c AS Counter, v AS Value, t AS "Sampled (UTC)"
FROM x WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY host, scope, o, c

SELECT TOP 1000
  REPLACE(REPLACE(g.DisplayName, 'Replicated folder ', ''), ' on ' + LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1), '') AS "Replicated folder",
  LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) AS Host,
  CASE g.HealthState WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS Health,
  g.StateLastModified AS LastStateChange
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g
WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (${fshost:singlequote})
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServer.DFSR.ReplicatedFolder')
ORDER BY CASE g.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, 3, 1

panels.description: Staging, conflict and deleted space in use by DFS Replication, per server.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time,
         REPLACE(r.CounterName, ' In Use', '') + ' (' + h.DisplayName + ')' AS metric,
         AVG(p.SampleValue) AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType et ON et.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServ%'
    AND r.ObjectName = 'DFS Replicated Folders' AND r.CounterName IN ('Staging Space In Use', 'Conflict Space In Use', 'Deleted Space In Use')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${fshost:singlequote})
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), e.DisplayName, et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName, h.DisplayName, r.CounterName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime,
         REPLACE(r.CounterName, ' In Use', '') + ' (' + h.DisplayName + ')',
         AVG(p.AverageValue)
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType et ON et.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServ%'
    AND r.ObjectName = 'DFS Replicated Folders' AND r.CounterName IN ('Staging Space In Use', 'Conflict Space In Use', 'Deleted Space In Use')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${fshost:singlequote})
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, e.DisplayName, et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName, h.DisplayName, r.CounterName
) x ORDER BY time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time,
         CASE WHEN et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.Service.SMB.10.0' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(e.DisplayName, 'SMB service ', ''), ' on ' + h.DisplayName, '') + ' (' + h.DisplayName + ')' ELSE h.DisplayName END AS metric,
         AVG(p.SampleValue) AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType et ON et.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServ%'
    AND r.ObjectName + '|' + r.CounterName = '${fscounter}'
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${fshost:singlequote})
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), e.DisplayName, et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName, h.DisplayName, r.CounterName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime,
         CASE WHEN et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServices.Service.SMB.10.0' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(e.DisplayName, 'SMB service ', ''), ' on ' + h.DisplayName, '') + ' (' + h.DisplayName + ')' ELSE h.DisplayName END,
         AVG(p.AverageValue)
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType et ON et.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.FileServ%'
    AND r.ObjectName + '|' + r.CounterName = '${fscounter}'
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${fshost:singlequote})
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, e.DisplayName, et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName, h.DisplayName, r.CounterName
) x ORDER BY time

FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
